description: This Kotlin source file defines the SqliteNotesStore class, which provides CRUD operations for notes stored in an SQLite database within an Android application. It manages database creation, upgrade, and various data access methods such as insert, update, delete, and queries for individual or all notes.

classes.name: SqliteNotesStore
classes.description: A helper class providing SQLite database access for notes storage, implementing CRUD operations and database schema management.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates the notes table and index when the database is first created.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Handles database schema upgrade by dropping the existing notes table and recreating it.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new note into the database with the provided title and content, returning the newly generated ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with new title and content, and updates the 'updatedAt' timestamp.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the note with the specified ID from the database.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID; returns null if the note does not exist.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all notes ordered by last update time descending.
